te: “Manchester United” defeated for the first time in the Champions League “Sabah”
de: English "Manchester United" won over Azerbaijani "Sabah" in the match of the first round of the general stage of the Champions League season-2026/2027. This is reported by the correspondent of “Tape.ru”
